system.description:
When a creature hits the wearer in melee, that creature must save vs. spells with a +4 bonus or be charmed. A person is affected as charm person. Any other living creature is affected as charm monster.

Only one successful charm can occur per day. A successful save does not use that success. The charm follows the usual charm rules: the creature treats the wearer as its best friend, may refuse orders against its nature, and breaks free if the wearer attacks it.

The hit and the save are manual. Apply the Charmed condition from the chat card.
